product.title: Private Central Highlands Driving Tour

description.text: Escape central Edinburgh on a private central Highlands driving day, with castles, waterfalls, historic villages, and an optional whisky distillery stop shaped to the group. The local driver-guide handles the road day so visitors stay with scenery rather than rental-car logistics. Stops include Edinburgh, Central Highlands. Hotel pickup and drop-off in Edinburgh are included, with booster seats available for children and entrance fees for castles or a distillery listed with the booking. Advice on traditional food stops can be added along the route. Ideal for visitors basing in Edinburgh who want a customizable private Highlands day without self-driving mountain roads.

highlights: Explore the central Highlands with a private tour
Adjust the itinerary according to your interests
Visit a whisky distillery, historic castles, and scenic waterfalls

start.description: We will pick up from any Edinburgh hotel, BnB or Port. Pick up in locations outwith Edinburgh will require and additional fee if it is possible for us to get there.

end.description: Return to your Edinburgh meeting point after the final stop on the itinerary.
